_about: UI contract for the vehicle screen. Cards and tabs are registered here; ui-lint warns on anything unregistered or out of order. Order lists are the INTENDED top-to-bottom order (runtime order check comes with the Playwright phase). To add a card: add its exact title under the right tab, in the right place.
principles: Findings before facts, facts before reference, reference before promotion.
Card icons are one neutral tone; red/amber/green mean status and appear only in pills, banners and insight rows.
A promotion card is never the first card of a tab.
A 'no data' card is folded into one shared card when two or more have none.

recalls: ייתכן שמגיעה לכם הטבה מהסדר פשרה

_screens: Bottom navigation (from the de-clutter build): חיפוש (home), הרכבים שלי (cars), התראות (alerts). Home cards come after the attention line, recent checks and the tools list; cars and alerts have their own large titles and no search band.
